name: Snow Girls
source:
A snow girl.  

A girl who flutters down from the sky saving people who are trapped in the snow.  In the middle of December, one of the harshest blizzards had just started outside and there was talks of this girl making an appearance...

Or at least that's what the rumour around town was; not that Angelette actually cared she had much better things to worry about!

It was the middle of December, and Angelette and her friends had decided to do some last minute Christmas shopping at the mall.  Or at least that's what was supposed to happen. When she arrived not a single one of her friends were there.

Instead...

There was a mysterious snowy girl.

[From  [url=https://lynis.itch.io/snow-girls]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个雪姑娘。

从天而降的少女，拯救被困在雪地里的人们。十二月中旬，外面刚刚开始一场最猛烈的暴风雪，有传言说这个女孩会出现……

或者至少镇上流传的谣言是这样的；并不是说安吉丽特真的在乎，她还有更重要的事情要担心！

那是十二月中旬，安吉丽特和她的朋友们决定在最后一刻去商场采购圣诞礼物。或者至少那是应该发生的事情。当她到达时，她的一个朋友都没有在那里。

相反…

有一位神秘的雪女。
